title: Hijri month overrides
description: Confirmed sightings of the 1st of each Hijri month for Pakistan. Every entry must cite at least one public source URL. Opened as a pull request by the watcher or contributed by hand.

coverage_start.description: Earliest Gregorian date covered by the confirmed record, or null when there are no confirmed months yet.

months.description: Map of the Hijri 1st (YYYY-MM-DD) to the Gregorian date it began and its sources.

sources.description: At least one public source URL confirming the sighting.
